  • Develop and execute PR and corporate communications strategies to strengthen brand reputation and event visibility.

  • Oversee corporate websites, social media, EDMs and digital communication channels, ensuring timely and consistent content.
  • Develop communications materials including speeches, key messages, Q&As, corporate announcements and marketing collateral.
  • Support event communications, media accreditation, registration communications and onsite media operations.
  • Build relationships with local, regional and international media, industry associations and strategic partners.
  • Support crisis communications and corporate initiatives where required.
  • Manage assigned community and engagement programmes and initiatives.
  • Track media coverage and communications performance, providing insights and recommendations.
  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage projects, timelines and budgets.

Requirements

  • Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing or a related discipline. Relevant Diploma holders will also be considered.
  • Assistant Manager: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Manager: Minimum 8 years of relevant experience, with experience leading communications initiatives and managing agencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, media relations and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing PR agencies, vendors and external partners.
  • Familiarity with CMS, EDM and social media platforms.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and/or Canva, including basic graphic design, photo editing and digital content creation, will be an advantage.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in events, exhibitions or MICE will be an advantage.
  • Proactive, resourceful and able to work independently.

col_04_category: Category C: Public Relations and Corporate Communications
col_18_responsibilities:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

  • Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.
  • Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.
  • Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.
  • Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.
  • Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.
  • Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Requirements

  • Experience working in the entertainment and nightlife industry
  • Able to work on weekends and public holidays if required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
  • Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.
  • Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.
  • Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in relevant software and tools.
  • Knowledge of mandarin dialect is essential as our customer base is primarily mandarin speaking
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to work late-night hours up to 3am, including weekends and public holidays

We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

col_03_title: Senior Manager, Communications and Public Relations
col_04_category: Category C: Public Relations and Corporate Communications
col_18_responsibilities:
About Centre for Fathering

Centre for Fathering (CFF) is a Singapore non-profit founded in 2000. We promote active fathering, strengthen families, and address issues arising from fatherlessness.

We champion the national Dads for Life and Mums for Life movements, and lead flagship initiatives including Back to School With Dad, Celebrating Fathers, Eat With Your Family Day, and Great Companies for Dads Awards.

Why This Role Matters

•       Shape the national conversation on fatherhood and family life in Singapore.

•       Translate programme impact into stories that move policymakers, corporate partners, donors, and families.

•       Build the public voice of a25-year-old movement as father-inclusive culture gains ground across workplaces, schools, and communities.

Position Summary

The SeniorManager, Communications and Public Relations leads CFF's strategic positioning and public voice, shaping narratives that advance father-inclusive culture, strengthen brand credibility, and inspire public support.

We are looking for an exceptional writer and storyteller who can turn programme outcomes into human-centred stories, with strong editorial judgement and a visual eye to direct design output from in-house and agency partners.

Familiarity with the evolving role of fathers in Singapore is a strong advantage. The role partners with leadership, programme teams, creative partners, and media to drive integrated communications across earned media, digital, campaigns, and thought leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Communications and Editorial Leadership

•       Develop and execute CFF'sintegrated communications strategy, aligned to organisational and fundraising priorities.

•       Position CFF as a leading voice in fathering and family development through research-backed narratives.

•       Advise the CEO and leadership on public messaging, and draft speeches, op-eds, forewords, and high-level correspondence.

•       Translate programme insights into human-centred impact stories and publishable narratives.

•       Oversee newsletters, the annual report, and donor communications, ensuring editorial consistency across channels.

•       Partner with digital teams to align messaging with CRM segmentation and audience lifecycles.

•       Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for research, drafting, and media monitoring, upholding accuracy and source verification.

2. Media Relations and Public Engagement

•       Build relationships with journalists, editors, and media partners across mainstream and vernacular platforms.

•       Develop press releases, pitches, Q&A documents, and interview briefs for spokespersons.

•       Secure meaningful coverage tied to campaign moments and thought leadership opportunities.

•       Report media performance to management and the board — reach, sentiment, and message pull-through.

•       Identify commentary opportunities in national discussions on family, parenting, and workplace culture.

3. Campaigns, Brand, and Creative Direction

•       Lead communications plans for national initiatives (for e.g., Celebrating Fathers, Back to School With Dad)and fundraising campaigns.

•       Direct visual storytelling with designers, videographers, and creative agencies. Graphic design execution is not required, but strong visual judgement and the ability to brief and critique creative output are essential.

•       Align message, design, and audience across social, website, EDM, and print.

•       Own the master content calendar and set the editorial rhythm across platforms.

4. Stakeholder and Partner Communications

•       Develop messaging frameworks for corporate, community, and government stakeholders.

•       Align Dads for Life and Mums for Life communications so both reinforce a coherent CFF brand.

•       Craft fundraising and donor stewardship narratives with the development team.

•       Coach internal teams on message discipline, tone of voice, and brand standards.

What We Are Looking For

Required

•       Bachelor's in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.

•       6–8 years in strategic communications, PR, or editorial roles.

•       High-quality writing across long-form and short-form formats (portfolio or samples required at application).

•       Track record engaging senior stakeholders and securing earned media.

•       Familiarity with Singapore's media landscape.

•       Sound editorial judgement and ability to work independently in a lean team.

Advantageous

•       Experience in non-profit, public sector, or purpose-driven organisations.

•       Working knowledge of parenting, fathering, or family development issues.

•       Comfort with AI-assisted content, analytics, and media monitoring tools.

•       Bilingual in English and Mandarin, Malay, or Tamil for vernacular media.

How to Apply

Email your CV,a one-page cover note, and two to three writing samples (or a portfolio link)to hr@fathers.com.sg. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a writing exercise.

Job Summary
Responsible for planning and executing public relations and communications initiatives across Southeast Asia, while managing media relations in Singapore. This role covers regional PR strategy, agency management, corporate communications, sustainability reporting, and internal communications to strengthen the company's brand and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Regional & Singapore PR

  • Develop and implement integrated PR and communications strategies across Southeast Asia.
  • Manage media relations and press engagement in Singapore.
  • Create and oversee press releases, media materials, executive messaging, and thought leadership content.
  • Support product launches, marketing campaigns, and PR activations.
  • Collaborate with regional teams to ensure consistent messaging and campaign execution.
  • Manage regional PR agencies and monitor performance against agreed KPIs, including media coverage and campaign effectiveness.

Sustainability Communications & Reporting

  • Coordinate the regional sustainability reporting process with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Consolidate and validate sustainability data across markets to ensure reporting accuracy and compliance.
  • Support the preparation, review, and verification of sustainability report content.
  • Track project timelines and coordinate activities to ensure timely completion of sustainability initiatives.

Internal & Corporate Communications

  • Manage internal communications, including monthly newsletters and employee engagement content.
  • Support the development of corporate messaging and executive communications.
  • Prepare briefing materials, interview talking points, speeches, and Q&A documents for company spokespersons.
  • Ensure consistent messaging across all internal and external communication channels.

Requirements

  • Degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of experience in public relations or corporate communications, preferably in a regional role.
  • Strong media relations experience with a proven ability to build and maintain media networks.
  • Experience managing external PR agencies and driving performance against established KPIs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong stakeholder management abilities.
  • Able to manage multiple projects and work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively in one other official language (to support diverse stakeholder engagement)

Job Summary

Coordinate and manage public relations activities for construction projects, engaging residents and stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution and effective communication.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate public relations programs for construction projects to engage residents and stakeholders
  • Explain and demonstrate the locations and purposes of Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) retrofit provisions to residents
  • Respond promptly to enquiries and feedback from residents, consultants, and authorities to resolve issues effectively
  • Take proactive measures to mitigate complaints arising from construction activities and suggest fall-prevention measures on-site when needed
  • Arrange timely execution of works within flats to minimize disruption
  • Liaise proactively with statutory boards, government departments (e.g., HDB, PUB, Town Councils), and subcontractors to facilitate smooth project progress
  • Manage public requests and complaints, maintain detailed records, and track feedback cases to closure to ensure accountability
  • Prepare and deliver monthly project reports and weekly updates to keep stakeholders informed
  • Collaborate closely with contractors to address and reduce complaints related to construction activities
  • Provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure efficient office and project operations
  • Execute administrative duties accurately and timely to support project workflows
  • Uphold and enhance the company’s reputation through effective stakeholder engagement and maintain positive relations with residents
  • Attend construction working committee meetings and provide administrative and logistical support, including meetings scheduled outside normal working hours (9am to 11pm)
  • Perform additional administrative tasks and ad-hoc duties as required

Required competencies and certifications

  • Competency in managing public relations issues and handling project queries effectively with residents
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively in one other official language (to support diverse stakeholder engagement)

Preferred competencies and qualifications

  • GCE 'A' Level qualification with at least 2 years of public relations experience, preferably in the building trade

col_18_responsibilities:
Company / 公司： ShengWang Tech
Location / 工作地点： The Great World, Singapore
Employment Type / 类型： Full-time / Internship 全职 / 实习
Headcount / 招聘人数： 1

About the Role / 岗位介绍

ShengWang Tech is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Social Media & Marketing Executive / Intern to build and manage our social media presence from 0 to 1 in the Singapore market.

You will independently take ownership of our social media channels, from account setup and content planning to content creation, publishing, community engagement and performance analysis.

This is not a role limited to posting content. We are looking for someone with strong ownership, learning agility and execution ability, who can gradually grow with the business and take on broader marketing responsibilities.

ShengWang Tech 正在招聘一名 社交媒体与市场运营专员 / 实习生，面向新加坡市场，从 0 到 1 搭建并运营公司的社交媒体矩阵。

你将相对独立地负责公司社媒账号的搭建、内容规划、内容制作、发布、用户互动及数据分析，并持续探索适合业务的内容和增长方式。

这并不是一个单纯“发帖”的岗位。我们希望找到一位具有较强 Ownership、学习能力和综合执行能力 的成员，未来随着业务发展，逐步承担更完整的市场营销工作。

Key Responsibilities / 工作职责

1. Social Media 0–1 Setup & Operations

社媒账号 0–1 搭建与运营

· Build and manage ShengWang Tech’s social media presence from the ground up.

· Develop appropriate positioning, content pillars, tone of voice and operating approaches for different platforms.

· Manage day-to-day publishing, account maintenance and community engagement.

主要平台包括：

International Platforms / 国际平台

· Facebook

· Instagram

· TikTok

· X

· Other relevant platforms

Chinese Platforms / 中文平台

· 小红书 Xiaohongshu / RED

· 抖音 Douyin

· 微信视频号 WeChat Channels

· 其他适合业务发展的平台

针对不同平台的用户群体、内容生态和传播机制，制定相应的运营方式，而非简单进行同一内容的跨平台复制。

2. Content Planning & Creation

内容策划与制作

· Develop monthly and weekly content calendars.

· Identify relevant topics, trends and content opportunities.

· Create social-first content including posts, graphics, short-form videos and other formats.

· Write and adapt content in both English and Chinese.

· Localise content for Singapore audiences while considering different cultural and platform contexts.

· Coordinate basic photography, videography and editing where required.

负责日常选题、文案、图片、短视频等内容的策划和制作，并根据国际平台和中文平台特点进行针对性调整。

能够完成基础内容制作，不要求候选人是专业摄影师或设计师，但需要具备良好的内容审美和较强的动手能力。

3. Growth & Community Management

用户增长与社区运营

· Monitor comments, messages and audience feedback.

· Engage with users and help build the company’s online community.

· Experiment with different content formats and growth approaches.

· Explore collaborations, trending topics, creators/KOL/KOC opportunities and relevant communities where appropriate.

持续寻找能够提升品牌曝光、粉丝增长和用户互动的有效方式，而不是机械执行固定内容计划。

4. Performance Analysis & Optimisation

数据分析与持续优化

· Track key social media metrics such as reach, views, engagement, follower growth and traffic.

· Review content performance regularly and identify what works and what does not.

· Turn insights into concrete improvements to future content and campaigns.

· Prepare simple periodic performance reports.

我们希望你不仅关注“发布了多少内容”，也关注 哪些内容有效、为什么有效，以及下一步如何做得更好。

5. Marketing Support & Future Development

市场营销及岗位发展

As the role develops, responsibilities will gradually expand beyond social media into broader marketing activities, including:

· Marketing campaign planning and execution

· Business/product promotion

· Online and offline campaign support

· Promotional materials and marketing content

· Partnership and collaboration initiatives

· Brand communication

· Supporting day-to-day marketing operations for relevant business lines

随着业务和岗位的发展，该职位未来将逐步从 Social Media 扩展至更完整的 Marketing 职能，包括业务线的日常市场运营、品牌宣传、活动策划、营销项目执行以及其他相关工作。

Requirements / 任职要求

What We Care About Most / 我们最看重的

Strong Ownership

You are willing to take responsibility for outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks. When facing something unfamiliar, your first reaction should be to research, learn, experiment and solve the problem.

具备很强的 Ownership。相比“等任务、等指导”，我们更希望你能够主动发现问题、研究问题并推动解决。

Fast & Independent Learner

Social media platforms, algorithms, tools and trends change quickly. We expect you to be able to independently learn new platforms, tools and working methods.

具备较强的独立学习能力，能够快速学习新的平台、工具、业务和工作方式。

Bilingual Communication

· Fluent in both English and Chinese, written and spoken.

· Able to create natural content in both languages rather than relying solely on literal translation.

· Daily internal communication will be primarily in Chinese.

中英文听说读写流利，能够根据不同受众独立完成中英文内容，而不仅仅进行直译。公司内部日常沟通以中文为主。

Social Media Native

You should have a strong understanding of social media and preferably be an active user of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Xiaohongshu or similar platforms.

对社交媒体有较强敏感度，理解短视频、图文内容及不同平台的基本内容逻辑和用户习惯。

Preferred / 加分项

The following are advantages, but not mandatory:

· Experience managing social media accounts, personal or commercial

· Experience with TikTok / Instagram Reels / Xiaohongshu / Douyin

· Short-form video shooting and editing skills

· Familiarity with CapCut / 剪映, Canva, Adobe or similar tools

· Basic photography or visual design skills

· Experience in digital marketing, branding, e-commerce or content marketing

· Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads or other paid social platforms

· Personal social media accounts or a content portfolio demonstrating your ability

· Good understanding of Singapore’s local consumer and social media environment

有社媒运营、短视频制作、设计、摄影、Marketing、电商或个人自媒体经验均为加分项，但不是硬性要求。

相比单纯的学历或工作年限，我们更看重 实际能力、学习速度、审美、执行力以及解决问题的能力。

AI-Friendly Workplace / 欢迎使用 AI

We actively encourage the appropriate use of AI tools to improve productivity and creativity.

You are welcome to use AI for:

· Research and brainstorming

· Content ideation

· Copywriting

· Translation and localisation

· Image and video creation

· Data analysis

· Workflow automation

· Learning new skills

We care about the quality of the final output and your judgement, rather than whether every task is completed manually.

我们欢迎并鼓励合理使用 AI。

可以使用 ChatGPT 等 AI 工具辅助信息研究、创意、文案、翻译、图片与视频制作、数据分析、自动化以及学习。

我们关注的是 最终结果、你的判断力以及解决问题的能力，而不是要求所有工作必须手工完成。

Who We Think Will Fit / 我们期待的你

You may be a good fit if you:

· Are proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Enjoy figuring things out from scratch.

· Have good judgement and attention to detail.

· Are creative but also execution-oriented.

· Are comfortable working independently.

· Are curious about new tools, technologies and AI.

· Want to grow beyond social media into broader marketing responsibilities.

如果你喜欢从 0 到 1 做事情，遇到问题愿意自己研究，希望自己的工作能够真正影响业务，而不是只执行固定流程，这个岗位会比较适合你。

Fresh graduates and students are welcome to apply. Strong portfolios, personal projects or demonstrated capabilities may be more valuable than years of experience.

欢迎优秀应届毕业生及实习生申请。我们不会单纯以工作年限判断候选人，优秀的作品、个人项目和实际能力同样重要。

col_03_title: Public Relations (Media Relations & Operations) (Government Sector | Contract 11 Months | Salary Up to $3,300) JO29391
col_04_category: Category C: Public Relations and Corporate Communications
col_05_industry: Advertising / Media, Events / Promotions, Marketing / Public Relations
col_18_responsibilities:
Key Highlights

  • Contract Duration: 11months
  • Salary: Up to $3,300/month
  • Work Location: CREATE Tower, NUS University Town
  • Working Hours: Mon to Thu: 9am to 6.30pm | Fri: 9am to 6pm

• Opportunity to support communications across media relations, events, digital assets, and communications operations
• Exposure to media engagement, official events, public communications, digital asset management, and stakeholder coordination involving media representatives, government agencies, and internal teams

Key Responsibilities

Media Relations Support

• Maintain and update media contact database, including journalists, editors, and media outlets across print, broadcast, and digital platforms
• Support the coordination of media accreditation and logistics for events, press conferences, and official visits
• Liaise with media representatives on-site and provide coordination support during media engagements
• Assist in preparing media briefs and supporting materials for interviews, press conferences, and public engagements

Ad-hoc On-site Event Support

• Provide on-site media and communications support at events, including registration and coordination of media-related logistics and operations
• Assist with media liaison duties, including coordination with accredited media representatives during interviews, briefings, and showcases
• Support the preparation, printing, and distribution of press kits, including fact sheets, backgrounders, programme information, and multimedia materials
• Support post-event administrative follow-up, including compiling media attendance records and feedback where applicable

Digital Repository & Photo Asset Management

• Manage and maintain digital repositories, including SharePoint and Google Drive, ensuring files are properly organized, named, and accessible to relevant team members
• Conduct regular housekeeping and archiving of shared drives and repositories, ensuring consistent folder structures and naming conventions
• Manage photo repository, including indexing, tagging, and archiving images from events, official visits, and media engagements
• Coordinate with photographers and videographers to ensure timely delivery, organization, and proper filing of multimedia assets

Service Manager, Mailbox Management

• Monitor and manage the Service Manager's mailbox, ensuring incoming feedback, enquiries, and complaints are acknowledged and routed to the appropriate officers in a timely manner
• Maintain an accurate tracking log of cases, including date received, nature of feedback, assigned officer, and resolution status
• Follow up with the Communications team to ensure cases are addressed within stipulated service standards and timelines

Asset Stocktaking &Inventory Management

• Conduct regular stocktaking of the Communications Directorate’s physical assets, including event equipment, collateral, branded merchandise
• Maintain an up-to-date inventory register, tracking asset condition, location, and usage, particularly during and after events
• Identify and flag items requiring repair, replacement, or disposal, and assist with the necessary administrative processes

Administrative &Operational Support

• Maintain the Communications Directorate’s filing systems, procurement records, and vendor documentation
• Support communications-related procurement activities, including obtaining vendor quotations, processing purchase orders, and managing invoices
• Provide general administrative and operational support to the Communications Directorate

Requirements

• Diploma/Degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Media Studies, or a related discipline preferred
• Minimum 1–2 years of experience in communications, public relations, media,or a related field
• Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English
• Experience with digital asset management, SharePoint, or Google Driveadministration is an advantage
• Experience in procurement is an added advantage
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks anddeadlines

col_03_title: Head of Investor and Public relations
col_04_category: Category C: Public Relations and Corporate Communications
col_18_responsibilities:
Head of Investor & Public Relations

Company Profile

YY Force Inc. is a Singapore-headquartered, technology-enabled workforce solutions provider listed on the NASDAQ. Established in 2010, the Group specializes in on-demand staffing, integrated facilities management, and smart workforce solutions across multiple industries. Leveraging innovative technology and data-driven platforms, YY Force connects businesses with reliable manpower while delivering efficient operational solutions across Singapore and the region.

As we continue to expand, we are seeking a dynamic and strategic Head of Investor & Public Relations to strengthen our corporate reputation, enhance investor confidence, and drive effective communication with shareholders, media, and key stakeholders.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Investor& Public Relations to lead the company's investor communications, media relations, and corporate reputation initiatives. This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with investors, shareholders, analysts, media, and other key stakeholders while ensuring transparent, timely, and consistent communication aligned with the company's business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the Company's Investor Relations (IR) and Public Relations (PR) strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, shareholders, analysts, media, and key stakeholders.
  • Prepare investor presentations, earnings announcements, annual reports, SGX/NASDAQ-related communications, press releases, and corporate materials.
  • Coordinate investor meetings, earnings calls, roadshows, conferences, and shareholder engagements.
  • Communicate the Company's financial performance, business strategy, and growth plans to the investment community.
  • Monitor market trends, analyst reports, investor sentiment, and competitor activities to provide strategic recommendations to senior management.
  • Lead media relations by preparing press releases, media statements, interviews, and corporate announcements.
  • Develop and implement crisis communication strategies to protect and strengthen the Company's reputation.
  • Ensure all external communications comply with applicable regulatory and disclosure requirements.
  • Collaborate with senior management, Finance, Legal, HR, and business units on corporate communications and branding initiatives.
  • Manage the Company's corporate image, reputation, and communication channels.
  • Oversee external PR agencies, communication consultants, and media partners where required.
  • Measure and report the effectiveness of investor relations and public relations initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Investor Relations, Public Relations, Corporate Communications, or a similar leadership role.
  • Experience with a publicly listed company is highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate governance, financial reporting, and regulatory disclosure requirements.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Ability to communicate complex financial and business information effectively.
  • Experience managing media relations and crisis communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
